_doc: Hand-curated NBA playoff series state. Used by nbaGameContextCache to override the 12-game minutes-trend window when the game has elimination/closeout stakes. Each entry keyed by ISO date, values are arrays of games with context flags. The MVP cure for 2026-05-31 lesson: SGA/Caruso/Dylan Harper MINS ↓ tag fired during Game 7 closeout where starters actually played MORE not less. Operator-editable as new playoff games scheduled.

_schema.matchup: string — exactly matches matchup field on tracked_bets rows
_schema.homeTeam: string — used to determine which team is at home
_schema.isElimination: boolean — winner advances, loser eliminated (true for all Game 7s; true when trailing team is at game point in 1-elim)
_schema.isGame7: boolean — exactly game 7 of a series
_schema.facingElimination: string[] — team names whose season ends if they lose this game
